title: Emerald outlined netherite
description: This adds a emerald collor outline to netherite.
body:
# Emerald Outlined Netherite
Give your Netherite gear a luxurious upgrade! This resource pack adds a bold emerald-green outline to all Netherite items, including:

- Netherite Ingot
- Netherite Sword
- Netherite Axe
- Netherite Shovel
- Netherite Hoe
- Netherite Pickaxe

### Why download it?

- Eye-Catching Design: Make your Netherite tools pop with a rich emerald-green accent that feels rare and prestigious.
- Perfect for Builders & Adventurers: Adds a stylish, high-value look to your gear without changing the original Minecraft vibe.
- Lightweight & Compatible: Works smoothly with most resource packs and shaders for a seamless experience.

Turn your Netherite into a gem-worthy treasure and stand out in every adventure!

## Terms of Use

You are free to use this resource pack in Minecraft, your videos, and your modpacks.

If you include it in a modpack or showcase it in a video, I would appreciate it if you add a link to this page in the description.

_**Do not redistribute or claim the pack as your own.**_
